newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan cotton rates close steady, seen stable.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan cotton rates close steady, seen stable.

text.p: Pakistani cotton rates closed steady on Tuesday amid less demand from spinners and are likely to open stable on Wednesday, brokers said.
A lack of buying interest by mills and unsold stocks of about 1.8 million 375-lb bales kept the market sentiment depressed, broker Nasim Usman said.
He said the rates were likely to fluctuate in a narrow range in the absence of exporters who had not entered the market owing to high prices.
In the kerb market, the NIAB-78 variety was quoted between 2,250 and 2,350 rupees per maund (37.32 kg) Usman said.
